claims.text: Yes. Either party may terminate the agreement for convenience, without cause, on 30 days' written notice.

citations.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause at any time effective upon thirty (30) days' written notice.

claims.text: Termination does not relieve the Customer of its payment obligations. The Customer must still pay all amounts due, on a timely basis, regardless of how the agreement is terminated.

citations.quote: no termination of this Agreement for any reason whatsoever shall relieve the Customer of the obligation to pay all amounts due to i-on and to make such payments on a timely basis.

claims.text: Separately from termination for convenience, either party may decline to renew. Non-renewal notice must be given at least fifteen days before the end of the current term.
